rv.q: Sean Hayes gives a consummate, larger-than-life performance as Oscar, channelling a profoundly unsettled, manic energy, constantly twitching, rocking in his chair and performing obsessive-compulsive ticks
Hayes’s brilliance elevates it into a must-see
Hayes unleashes a virtuoso piano performance in which all his torment spills out over the keys, his passionate playing sapping him and sustaining him all at once
Wright provides a good 15 minutes of anticipation building before Oscar appears
